event_name: Haas F1 Team Document 44 Date 24 June 2018 Time 17:08 2018 FRENCH GRAND PRIX 21 - 24 June 2018 The Stewards The Stewards, having received a report from the Race Director, have considered the following matter and determine the following
fact: Car 8 left the track at turn 3 and rejoined the track at turn 5.
offence: Alleged breach of Article 27.3 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations.
reason: The Stewards reviewed video evidence from on board cars 8, 11 and 5. Cars 8 was hit in the rear by car 5, forcing Car 8 to leave the track. Car 8 rejoined the track slightly behind Car 11 and in a safe manner. All Competitors are hereby reminded of their right to appeal certain
rules_referenced: Article 27.3 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations
stewards: as set out in the International Sporting Code
